name: watts-up
title: Watt's up
description: Check your Mac's power adapter wattage, charging power, battery health and charge status. Shows the negotiated power (watts, voltage, current) your charger delivers, plus battery level, cycle count and temperature — in Raycast or your menu bar.
author: mrmartineau

commands.subtitle: Watts Up

commands.name: energy-impact
commands.title: Show Energy Impact
commands.subtitle: Watts Up
commands.description: List the apps and processes using the most energy (runs a ~2s top sample only when launched)

commands.name: energy-settings
commands.title: Manage Energy Settings
commands.subtitle: Watts Up
commands.description: View and toggle Low Power Mode and Power Nap, see sleep timers and what's preventing sleep
